hints.title: Immediate Delivery Rate Computation
hints.text: Compute the percentage of orders where customer preferred date matches the initial order date, rounded to two decimals.

hints.title: Conditional Sum over Total Count
hints.text: Sum the matching date equality condition multiplied by 100 divided by total orders, formatted using round.

hints.title: Immediate Percentage Query Blueprint
hints.text: select round(100.0 * sum(case when order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) as immediate_percentage from Delivery.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS immediate_percentage
FROM Delivery;
```

complexity.notes: Single table scan evaluating conditional equality and aggregate counts executes in linear time with constant auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate queries for immediate and total orders double table traversal overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-line conditional expression tallies matches without intermediate table buffering.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) scaled by 100.

solutions.code:
